operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a manual stock adjustment (a stock-in or stock-out transaction) for a product in a warehouse.

The request body is wrapped under a `StockTransaction` object. The target product must be **active** and **quantity-tracked** (products tracked by serial/lot use Requisitions instead).

Server-controlled fields are set automatically and ignored if supplied: the source is fixed to *Manual*, the status to *Processed*, and `order_id`, `staff_id`, and `branch_id` are assigned by the server.

On success the endpoint responds with **202 Accepted** and the new transaction id.

Requires the **Adjust Product Inventory** permission.

product_id.description: Id of the product to adjust. The product must be active and quantity-tracked.

store_id.description: Id of the warehouse. Must be an active warehouse.

transaction_type.description:
Direction of the adjustment.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Stock in (add) |
| 2 | Stock out (remove) |

quantity.description: Quantity to add or remove (positive number). The sign for stock-out is handled by the server.

transaction_category_id.description: Transaction category, sent as an array; the first element is used and is resolved by id or created by name.

currency_code.description: Currency of the unit price. Recommended; combined with the account exchange rate.

price.description: Unit price. Defaults to the product's average price when omitted; for stock-out it may be set to the most recent purchase price.

received_date.description: Transaction date (account date format). Defaults to the current date/time when omitted. Must fall within an open financial period.

journal_account_id.description: Optional journal account used when the Accounting plugin is active.

attachment.description: Optional comma-separated list of uploaded image/file ids (a string, not an array).

unit_factor_id.description: Unit factor id. Only used when multi-units is enabled.

unit_factor.description: Unit factor value. Only used when multi-units is enabled.

unit_name.description: Unit name. Only used when multi-units is enabled.

unit_small_name.description: Unit short name. Only used when multi-units is enabled.

id.description: Id of the newly created stock transaction.

400.description: Insufficient stock for a stock-out, an `attachment` sent as an array, or a validation failure (e.g. suspended warehouse/branch or a closed-period date).

validation_errors.description: Field → list of error messages (present on validation failures).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid.

403.description: The user lacks the Adjust Product Inventory permission, or the product is not quantity-tracked.

404.description: The product does not exist, or is not in an active state.
